title: Server & route tests require Postgres
detail: vitest globalSetup (server/__tests__/globalSetup.ts) boots the full route tree and needs a database. Without DATABASE_URL/TEST_DATABASE_URL these tests fail. Locally use a TEST_DATABASE_URL; CI uses a postgres:16 service and runs `drizzle-kit push --force` before tests.

title: Some paid integrations hard-throw at import without env
detail: vitest.config.ts sets inert PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and SESSION_SECRET placeholders because server/paypal.ts and express-session throw at import when their vars are missing. Do not remove these placeholders or tests fail at import time.

title: Tenant-scoped query missing garageId filter
detail: Any read/write/aggregate over tenant data must filter by garageId. Dev mode without garageId may return all records, but production must enforce isolation. Never trust a client-supplied garageId — derive it from the authenticated session. AUTH_BYPASS=true is dev-only and must not gate real authorization.

title: Add backend routes in modular server/routes/, not legacy routes.ts
detail: New routes belong in server/routes/<name>.ts (loaded first, with priority); server/routes.ts is the legacy fallback. Keep handlers thin and validate input with shared Zod schemas.

title: Reuse shared domain math, never duplicate it
detail: VAT (15%), ZATCA QR/TLV, Hijri dates, Zakat (2.5%), and TRN validation live in shared/*Utils.ts and are unit-tested. Reuse them on both client and server; changing them requires updating their tests.

title: Do not edit server/paypal.ts
detail: server/paypal.ts is vendor-locked. Review and change its callers instead; never modify the file itself.

title: UI uses 7 archetype layout wrappers and enforced dark theme
detail: Pages compose one of StandardPageLayout, StandardTablePage, DashboardPage, FormPage, AnalyticsPage, MobileCardPage, TabsPageLayout. Grayscale design system, dark theme enforced (avoid white backgrounds), keep RTL/i18n working.
